- Target variable: dg_dt (Rate of change of postsynaptic conductance during clearance)
- Input features: t (time)

dg_dt = -k_decay * g - k_cooperative * g**2 / (K_half + g) - k_rebind * g / (K_buffer + g) * (1 - b / b_max) + k_reopen * c + k_unbuffer * b * g / (K_release + g)

      "rhs": "k_close * g - k_reopen * c - k_decay * c",
      "initial_condition": 0.0,
      "description": "Transient rebound reservoir of transmitter that unbound from receptors but remains in the cleft and can re-bind or be cleared"
    }

}
